newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe approves revenue collection authority.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe approves revenue collection authority.

text.p: The Zimbabwean government has approved the creation of a national revenue collection authority by merging the department of taxes with customs and excise, Finance Minister Herbert Murerwa said on Wednesday.
He told state media the Zimbabwe Revenue Collection Authority would be established soon, but gave no firm date.
"We now hope we can work quickly as some legal requirements have to be put in place," he said of the authority which President Robert Mugabe's government has been considering for years.
The government believes tax collection will improve considerably if handled by one body.
"We are going to see some changes once the authority becomes operational as it will provide a better service and improve efficiency," Murerwa said.
